verified_key_information_units.information: Headline financial performance: Revenue increased 40% to DKK 126.5m (2024: DKK 90.1m), EBITDA grew 26% to DKK 31.1m (2024: DKK 24.7m), and Profit Before Tax (EBT) surged 109% to DKK 19.0m (2024: DKK 9.1m), driven by scaling of core titles and ad revenue optimization.

candidate_sentences.text: Total revenue increased by 40% to DKK 126.5 million, significantly surpassing the initial guidance range of DKK 85–106 million.
Profitability metrics also improved substantially.
EBITDA rose by 26% to DKK 31.1 million, although the EBITDA margin slightly contracted to 25% from 27% in 2024 due to increased marketing spend aimed at capturing market share.
Profit before tax (EBT) more than doubled, increasing by 109% to DKK 19.0 million.

verified_key_information_units.information: The 'Big 3' titles—Airline Manager, Truck Manager, and Farm Manager—collectively generated 67% of 2025 revenue (DKK 85m) and 65% of EBITDA, driven by Truck Manager's foundational scaling (revenue growth from DKK 1.2m in 2024 to DKK 25.2m in 2025) and Farm Manager's successful July 2025 launch with 5 million pre-registrations.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Progress & Results section (pages 13-20); Game Breakdown table (page 13); Truck Manager section (page 17); Farm Manager section (page 18)

candidate_sentences.text: This top-line expansion was primarily driven by the strong performance of the company’s three largest titles, collectively referred to as the Big 3, which generated DKK 85 million in revenue, representing 67% of the total.
Truck Manager emerged as a major growth engine, with revenue surging to DKK 25.2 million from a base of DKK 1.2 million in 2024, following its late 2024 launch.
Farm Manager, released in July 2025, added DKK 22.0 million in revenue during its first six months.

verified_key_information_units.information: Strategic ad revenue optimization initiated in late September 2025 boosted In-App Ads (IAA) revenue by 100% to DKK 18.5m, improving monetization efficiency by eliminating platform fees and increasing IAA's share of total revenue to 14.6% (2024: 10.2%).
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Strategic Ad Revenue Optimisation section (pages 21-22); Financial Performance section (page 26)

candidate_sentences.text: The company’s operational strategy shifted to include a hybrid monetization model, with in-app advertising revenue doubling to DKK 18.5 million.
This shift improved direct cost efficiency, as advertising revenue is not subject to the platform fees applied to in-app purchases.

verified_key_information_units.information: 2026 financial guidance targets revenue of DKK 130-153m (+3% to +21%) and EBITDA of DKK 28-36m, with strategic focus on optimizing the existing portfolio, disciplined investment in Train Manager 2 and Space Manager, and maintaining margin discipline amid regulatory uncertainty.

candidate_sentences.text: Looking ahead to 2026, the company guides for revenue between DKK 130 million and DKK 153 million, supported by continued optimization of ad revenue and the upcoming release of Train Manager 2.

verified_key_information_units.information: Strong liquidity position with a 78% solvency ratio (2024: 86%), total equity of DKK 66.1m, and completion of a DKK 5m share buy-back program, reflecting a robust capital structure with no interest-bearing debt.

verified_key_information_units.information: Framework-driven development strategy enables cost-efficient title launches, portfolio-wide upgrades, and a competitive moat, as evidenced by reusable codebases and retrofitting features like staff management and stock markets across titles.

details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K3, K4, and K5 are all PRESENT with clear evidence in the candidate summary. K6 is MISSING because there is no mention of the framework-driven development strategy, reusable codebases, or retrofitting features across titles, which are core components of this criterion. The overall coverage is strong for financial performance, guidance, and liquidity, but the absence of strategic development framework details prevents a higher score.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements logically follow one another without contradictions. The revenue breakdown (S3-S7) consistently references the 'Big 3' titles and their contributions to total revenue. Profitability metrics (S8-S11) show logical cause-and-effect relationships between increased marketing spend and margin contraction. Operational changes (S13-S14) are clearly explained. Balance sheet information (S16-S17) provides context for cash flow fluctuations. Forward guidance (S18) logically builds on stated strategic initiatives. No material contradictions, logical gaps, organizational issues, or unnecessary repetitions are present.
